answer: A comet spends its light once — a ballot here should too. Each ballot signs its claim with a quill and burns $25 to a keyless eater address, as Counterparty did in 2014; the receipt must age a day before it votes. Ten thousand fakes hit the burn address and stay dead: $250,000 destroyed, zero refundable, receiptless ballots rejected — a US SMS check costs $0.26, but one burn buys exactly one ballot. Burn power decays 10% each epoch, so the farm re-burns $25,000 per epoch to hold its seats; one yarrow burn votes sixteen epochs. A farm that burns $250,000 for one vote never comes back.
